No words, numbers, UI, graphs, currency symbols, logos other than the referenced fox, no money piles, no cryptocurrency, no generic circuit-board backdrop. No human figures. No fake historical interface. Scene: the fox light sculpture is slowly revealed from a dark obsidian horizon in a vast quiet space, its ears magenta and lower face cyan. Atmosphere of calm foresight, no threat. The face occupies central upper half, entire geometry intact with dark margin around edges. Low wide camera, precise reflections, rich black negative space and confident simplicity. Masterpiece art direction, the fox observes tomorrow.

icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight original sculptural financial concept icons for Cash Cast website, a precise 4-column by 2-row contact sheet, landscape 1536x1024. Near-black ink background. Each icon entirely within the central 65% of an equal grid cell, generous dark gutters, no labels, no visible grid, no text or numerals. Unified exquisite smoked glass and titanium forms with thin electric cyan and magenta edge light, premium precise product photography, refined simple silhouettes that remain legible small. Row1 left to right: future income = a luminous incoming stream entering a calm reservoir; upcoming commitments = three dated event plaques on a rail; financial buffer = a transparent protective circular vessel around a small reserve; payment deadline = an elegant clock ring with a single sharp marker. Row2 left to right: goal = a small clear target with central light; scenario comparison = two parallel illuminated branching routes; forecast recalculation = a circular return arrow around a time disc; uncertainty = a route fading into a translucent fogged-glass edge. Absolutely no fox, no currency symbols, no coins, no finance bar/pie charts, no app UI, no logos, no fake text. Every object is separate and centred, consistent camera and lighting. Concepts, not a factual technical diagram.
